item.title: Kramer Free Pantry for Students
item.description:
A free food and hygiene pantry is located at the entrance of Kramer, available to all students. The pantry contains cereal, fruit, vegetables, peanut butter, spaghetti, mac and cheese, soup, shampoo, and toothbrushes. For questions, donations, or suggestions, contact Chelsea Pike, Kramer Social Worker at 513-273-3511 or pikec@talawanda.org.

item.title: Summer Scoops Literacy Camp for Grades 1-3
item.description:
Summer Scoops Literacy Camp is offering individualized support to nurture reading skills and confidence for incoming 1st-3rd graders. The camp runs July 14-16 from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM at Oxford Lane Library (441 S. Locust St., Oxford, OH 45056). Parents can use a QR code to sign up their child. This program is TSDP APPROVED for enrollment and is not affiliated with TSD.

item.title: 2026-2027 School Calendar Released
item.description:
The complete 2026-2027 school calendar for Talawanda Schools is now available. The calendar includes 170 school days, 4 teacher work days, 3 data collaboration days, 2 conference exchange days, and 3 professional development days, totaling 182 days. Key dates include: - First Day for K-12 Students: August 24, 2026 - Winter Break: December 21, 2026 - January 1, 2027 - Spring Break: March 15-19, 2027 - Last Day of School: June 27, 2027

Major breaks include Thanksgiving Break (November 25-27, 2026), conferences, and various professional development and teacher work days throughout the year.

item.title: Kramer PTG Mile Fundraiser - May 11th
item.description:
The Kramer Mile fundraiser is on May 11th, with each grade level running together down Sycamore Street adjacent to Kramer. Students can set up fundraising pages at https://app.99pledges.com/fund/kramermile26/addme to collect donations from family and friends. The grade level raising the most money wins an ice cream party, and top three individual fundraisers earn prize packs. item.title: Bantam Football & Cheerleading Registration 2026
item.description:
The Talawanda Bantam Football Association is accepting 2026 registration for youth tackle football (grades K-6th) and cheerleading programs. Registration must be completed online by June 1st.

Football registration ($220) includes reversible jersey, game pants, socks, practice jersey, and duffle bag. Cheerleading registration is $300 for new participants, $200 for returning (includes uniform, pom poms, cheer bag, crop top, brief, bow, socks, shoes, and pink socks).

Fittings and signing event scheduled for May. Returning cheerleaders will not receive new uniforms unless registered as new players. Contact: 513-503-8635 or tbfaregistrar@gmail.com. More info at www.talawandabantamfootballassociation.sportingin.com

item.title: Older Americans Month Community BINGO Challenge
item.description:
Older Americans Month celebrates older adults' contributions throughout May 2026 with the theme "Champion Your Health." Oxford Seniors, Age-Friendly Oxford, and the Coalition for a Healthy Community are hosting Community BINGO to promote physical, mental, and emotional health. Pick up a BINGO card at Oxford Seniors (922 Tollgate Dr.), Oxford Lane Library (441 S. Locust St.), The Knolls of Oxford, or Scripps Gerontology Center (396 Upham Hall), complete activities throughout May, and bring your completed card to the Intergenerational BINGO Party on May 31, 3:00-5:00 PM at Oxford Seniors for prizes and snacks.

item.title: Kramer Reading at Home Program Success
item.description:
Kramer's Reading at Home (RAH) program achieved remarkable participation this year, with 82% of K-2 students (208 readers) turning in at least one reading sheet. Nearly half submitted 10+ sheets, while 26 students read over 500 books and three students each read more than 1,000 books. Students collectively recorded over 39,000 books read and took home 1,000+ books from the RAH cart. Popular rewards included coupons to Oxford Doughnut Shoppe and Spring Street Treats.

item.title: Field Day, No School Days, and Recent Activities
item.description:
No school Monday, May 4th and Tuesday, May 5th. Field Day is scheduled for May 8th and volunteers are needed—sign up using the QR code or link on the flyer. All parents/guardians must have a background check on file with the board office to attend field trips (processing takes a few days). Recent highlights include 3rd and 5th graders completing testing, 1st graders painting ceramic tiles at You're Fired, 5th graders walking to Spring Street Treats for ice cream, and Kindergarteners visiting Farbach-Werner Nature Preserve.

item.title: Spring Conference Meals Thank You
item.description:
The Spring 2026 Conference Meals on March 12 & 17 successfully provided food for teachers during extra-long workdays at Kramer. Thanks to helpers and donors, there was plenty of food, smooth setup/cleanup, and even leftovers. Teachers posted sweet thank-you notes on refrigerators expressing gratitude. Special thanks to Kramer PTG and numerous volunteers including Andrea Bennett-Kenne, Jessica Brechin, Tomoko Brown, Jennifer Bulanda, and many others. Coordinators: Lois Meade & Tomoko Brown.
